verdict.rationale: Vapi documents assistant hooks that "automate actions when specific events occur during a call" [vapi-docs-43]. Built-in event-driven behaviors back this up: idle messages fire on inactivity, end-call phrases and call timeouts end calls, and tool triggers send `tool-calls` events to your Server URL. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the supported hook events, conditions and action types; any rule logic beyond the call scope; independent or hands-on corroboration.
